## 1. Literal map and the exact old factor

For n≥1 the carrier is all labelled functions on [n], and the selected
positive exponent n-r(f)+1 lies in [1,n]. Thus the literal update is closed.
Positive powers preserve exactly the original cyclic set C: cycle vertices
stay cyclic, and a return under f^e is already a return under f.

For L_f e_v=e_f(v), image labels are independent basis vectors. The cyclic
space W_C lies in every image and is acted on invertibly. Consequently
rank Q_f^e=r(f^e)-c and nullity Q_f^e=n-r(f^e). The quotient sends each
off-cycle basis vector to its parent or to zero, so it is nilpotent with
index h when h≥1. Linearization and the quotient both respect powers.
This proves Q_N(f)=Q_f raised to 1+nullity(Q_f).

On each fixed cyclic-set stratum, quotient similarity type is a surjective
factor onto the old nilpotent type system: disjoint chains of the prescribed
partition lengths, attached to C, realize every type. The original old
Propositions 1–4 and derivation sections 2–4 supply exactly its accumulated
exponent and Sylvester clock. This conclusion uses the original proof,
not the old owner's label or a summary.

It is not a full-carrier conjugacy. Quotient type forgets labels, cycle
permutations and attachment data. Injectivity of the full linearization
does not make this smaller quotient injective. Old partition-fibre counts
therefore cannot become labelled function-fibre counts.

## 2. Tail collapse and the full pointwise clock

Induction gives N^t(f)=f raised to E_t, with
E_(t+1)=E_t(1+delta(E_t)). The height of f^e is ceil(h/e), so
s=min{t:E_t≥h} is the first epoch of height at most one, not necessarily
entry into the recurrent set.

Before this epoch, delta(e)≥e follows from a deepest path (or the largest
nilpotent block). Comparing with a_(t+1)=a_t(a_t+1), a_0=1, gives the
sharp tail bound S(h). A single off-cycle chain attains it; hence the
tail-collapse maximum is S(n-1) for n≥2 and zero for n=1. This is the
old one-block nilpotent witness realized by a labelled function.

For singular f, put d=n-c+1≥2. At and after s, the image is C, so subsequent
exponents multiply by d. Powers with exponents at least h agree exactly
when their exponents agree modulo the original cycle LCM m. With
M=m/gcd(m,E_s), a return at epoch s+u after q further steps is equivalent to
M dividing d^u(d^q-1). Prime factors shared with d force u≥J; the remaining
coprime factors force q to be a multiple of ord_(M_perp)(d). No epoch
before s is recurrent because it has height at least two and eventually
leaves that height range permanently. This proves the stated full
transient s+J and period, including the empty-prime and modulus-one
conventions. Permutations are fixed separately.

Thus recurrence is exactly h≤1 with gcd(m,n-c+1)=1; fixedness is exactly
h≤1 with m dividing n-c. These cover n=1. The ordinary cyclic-group
power mechanism is already described by the read source, although its
referenced original Proposition 2.2 proof was not retrieved.
[Qureshi–Reis, section 2.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2107.00584v2)

The two hand controls check: the 13-label example has E=1,2,6,36,216,
s=2, M=4, J=2 and full transient 4>S(12)=3. The four-label example
(2,3,1,1) alternates with (3,1,2,2). Neither calculation was executed as a
pilot. They correctly exclude a total-transient Sylvester bound and
universal convergence to fixed functions.

## 3. Inverse slices do not supply the missing second axis

The union over k of roots f^k=g with rank f=n-k+1 is an exact disjoint
description because each source has one selected exponent. It is not an
evaluated every-target inverse. If g is a permutation, f must be one too,
so k=1 and the fibre is {g}.

If g is constant at v, any root has the same cyclic set {v}. Its graph is
one labelled rooted tree with a root loop. Exactly the nonroot leaves are
missing image labels, giving exponent L+1. The source maps to g exactly
when its height H≤L+1, including the singleton H=L=0. This is a correct
tree-class characterization, not an evaluated global maximum.

If rank g=n-1, a predecessor is singular of rank n-1 and its selected
exponent is two. Exactly one off-cycle leaf forces all off-cycle vertices
to lie in one chain. Its square has defect min(2,H), so H=1 is necessary.
A higher target height therefore has empty fibre. Otherwise the unique
off-cycle label z and gamma=g restricted to C determine all predecessors:
choose an ordinary square root sigma of gamma and attach z at sigma^-1(g(z)).
There is exactly one attachment for each sigma. The resulting count is
precisely the classical permutation square-root count, not a further
non-generic combinatorial choice.
[Leaños–Moreno–Rivera-Martínez, Theorem 1 and section 4.1](https://arxiv.org/html/1005.1531v3)

The old nilpotent zero-fibre extremizer remains on a different carrier.
No evaluated arbitrary labelled target, sharp full-fibre maximum or sharp
full-transient maximum has been established. No theorem from Kozyra's
unread later constant/identity-count proofs is imported.
